summary: Planned the re-scoped cell-index record as an eight-phase, five-wave falsify-first plan after research refuted the dispatch's TARGET (the gap-carrying three-coordinate index) uniformly in B and closed its route (C) alternative. No factorization lemma is committed to in any shape; the plan commits to a six-coordinate residue-carrying candidate behind a three-part falsification gate, an exhibited threshold/period theorem, the fourteenth wired evidence probe, and the record amendments that stop the refuted candidate being described as plausible. Twelve theorem signatures are pinned in a Lean Challenge Statements block, eleven of them transcribed from the two compiled research prototypes.

artifacts.summary: Eight phases, five waves, 9.5 hours: two cheap gates on the re-scoped index, the second-region-end hunt as a decision gate with both branches pre-specified, the eventual-periodicity theorem that exhibits the index parameters, the wired probe, its gate wiring, the in-tree record amendments, the counter-observables context note, and the full gate.
